title: chore(deps): move .objectstack-sha to the objectstack 18.1.0 release commit e649c2d91e (objectui#13440)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuQx8xAyxeMnyWkn84sEzqVb)_

Closes #13440
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Unblocks #13285 and #13305 (both wait for a pin that carries 18.1.0).

## The pin

- `.objectstack-sha` moves from `915e94049922` to `e649c2d91e270e3da26820bcfe54a28445305a75`, the objectstack 18.1.0 release commit ("chore: version packages", objectstack-ai/objectstack#25606). It carries objectstack-ai/objectstack#25483 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#25564, which objectstack-ai/objectstack#25251 required to ship in one release, so the same-release hold is met.
- **Ancestry, read in the objectstack checkout:** `git merge-base --is-ancestor e649c2d91e origin/main` exits 0, and the bump script reported "(on origin/main)". The `@objectstack/cli@18.1.0` tag peels to `e649c2d91e`.
- **The path:** `scripts/bump-objectstack.sh e649c2d91e270e3da26820bcfe54a28445305a75 --no-commit` (so the commit carries the repo's trailer pair), which fetched the sha and built and packed the 7 packages, then `pnpm install`.
- **What moved:** `.objectstack-sha` and the seven packed manifests in `.objectstack-pin/`. The manifests change only version strings, `18.0.0` to `18.1.0` (the package's own version and its `@objectstack/*` dependencies).
- **`pnpm-lock.yaml` is unchanged.** `pnpm install` left it byte-identical, and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exits 0. So the Dependabot lockfile PRs (#13438, #13439) do not overlap this one.
- `pnpm objectstack:status` answers `✓ built at the pin e649c2d91e27`.

## What the move breaks, and the follow-through in this PR

Each item below is red on the bare pin move and was fixed here because the failing check names its own fix. Nothing else changed.

### 1. The `external` tripwire in `@object-ui/auth` (objectui#13427)

`packages/auth/src/__tests__/org-roles.test.ts` › "spells external itself only while the pin predates objectstack#25515" went red as designed. Its message prescribes the swap, and this PR does exactly that:

- `packages/auth/src/org-roles.ts` re-exports the spec's `MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_EXTERNAL` as `ORG_ROLE_EXTERNAL` instead of spelling the literal. **The exported name and its value (`'external'`) are unchanged**, and its declared type is still the literal `"external"`, so `@object-ui/auth`'s public face does not move (Clause-② stays `no`). `ORG_ROLE_LABELS` is typed `Record<OrgRole, …>` again, with the `| typeof ORG_ROLE_EXTERNAL` union dropped.
- The tripwire test is deleted, with its now unused `@objectstack/spec` namespace import.
- `InviteMemberDialog.roleCap.test.tsx` and `org-i18n-holdouts-4474.test.tsx` now expect `external` in the invite dialog's role list. This is the spec's 18.1.0 vocabulary reaching `ORG_ROLES`, which objectui#13427's changeset already described: "Wherever the installed spec lists the role, the invite dialog offers it to every issuer who can invite". It is not a choice made by this card. The owner list gains `external`, and a delegated admin or an unloaded membership is offered `['member', 'external']`. The delegate test's name now says "offered member and external only".

### 2. `check:installed-pin-claims`: 34 present-tense "installed 18.0.0" stamps

The gate is blocking through `scripts/__tests__/check-installed-spec-pin-claims.test.ts`. The packed manifests now say 18.1.0, so it flagged 34 lines in 24 files, all comments or test description strings. No code changes.

**Every stamp was re-measured before it moved.** The method:

- The spec SOURCE diff between the two pins, `git diff --name-only 915e9404 e649c2d91e -- packages/spec/src`, touches only `automation/flow.zod.ts` (the `runAs` description text and a comment), `data/object.zod.ts` (the new `membershipKeys` key and its extension refusal), `identity/*` (the `external` role), `kernel/execution-context.zod.ts` and `security/explain.zod.ts` (descriptions and comments), `security/rls.zod.ts` (`MembershipKeysSchema`), `stack.zod.ts` (the duplicate membership-key refusal), `index.ts` (two new exports) and one semantic migration entry, plus tests.
- No claim's subject is in that set. The subjects are `ui/*` rows (`ViewDataSchema`, `ComponentPropsMap['object-calendar']` and `['object-kanban']`, list-view conditional formatting and card style rules, the chart and dashboard `aria` tombstones, record components, form section groups, master-detail details, the gantt `navigation` tombstone), `FieldSchema` and `SelectOptionSchema`, and flow node config (`waitForInput`, the single-brace mark, the canvas-seed save errors). The two claims about non-spec sources were checked at their own source: `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` (the `current_user` CEL message `celAuthoring.ts` quotes) has an empty diff between the pins, and the trigger packages changed only `CHANGELOG.md` and `package.json`.
- The test files that carry a claim, or pin a source file's claim, ran green at the new pin (see the verification comment).

Each stamp moves `18.0.0` to `18.1.0`. A stamp that carries its re-measure list (`objectui#12030, … objectui#13261`) gains `objectui#13440`, the same form objectui#13261 used. After the restamp the gate answers `34 at the pin` and `OK`.

### 3. `e2e/live/ci/backend.env`

`scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` › "pins OBJECTSTACK_VERSION to the version the lockfile resolves" went red. `OBJECTSTACK_VERSION` moves `18.0.0` to `18.1.0`. Its `@objectstack/cli@18.1.0` tag peels to this pin's commit, so the live lane's backend and the console's pin are the same release.

### 4. The `ObjectSchema` key-count guards in `app-shell`

`MetadataService.retiredObjectEnabled.test.ts` (line 157) and `MetadataService.specKeyObjectPayload.test.ts` (line 171) count the keys `ObjectSchema` accepts, and both went red with `expected 47 to be 46`. Spec 18.1.0 adds one key, `membershipKeys` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#25513). **Measured, not assumed:** the spec's own `authorable-surface/data.json` gains exactly `data/Object:membershipKeys` between `915e9404` and `e649c2d91e`, and loses nothing. Both guards now expect 47, and each carries a comment with that basis, in the same form as the earlier re-point (objectui#12971). The two files pass, 25 tests.

## Changeset

`.changeset/13440-objectstack-pin-e649c2d.md` declares `'@object-ui/auth': patch`. The published module now imports `MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_EXTERNAL` from `@objectstack/spec`, so it needs a spec that exports it (18.1.0 or later). `node scripts/objectstack-floor.mjs --dry-run` exits 0 and moves 37 ranges to `^18.1.0` at publish, so the published ranges will require that version. `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` pass.

## Acceptance notes

- The restamped comments in published packages (`types`, `core`, `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-designer`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-kanban`, `app-shell`) change no behaviour, so the changeset names `@object-ui/auth` only.
- After merge the seat reads #13285 and #13305 against the new pin, as the card says.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
